$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — AdapterDescriptor. Major version 1. Registration data by which the det CLI discovers and bounds an out-of-process adapter (TECH-ADR ADR-4/ADR-5). The descriptor is data: core never imports adapter code, it spawns the declared entry as a subprocess with a validated input contract. Platform ids appear only as VALUES here; the schema itself stays platform-neutral.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Adapter Descriptor

platformIds.description: Platform ids this adapter can probe. A profile whose platformId is outside this set fails closed with ADAPTER_NOT_APPLICABLE.

entry.description: Adapter executable path relative to the repository root (e.g. the compiled subprocess entry). Never absolute, never traversal.

inputContract.description: $id of the input-transport schema the adapter expects (adapters re-validate defensively).

outputContract.description: $id of the schema the adapter's stdout payload must validate against. The CLI hard-rejects stdout that fails it (ADAPTER_OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VIOLATION).

readOnly.description: Major 1 registers read-only probes only. A write-capable adapter requires a new schema major plus a stage GO ADR — fail closed by construction.
